message.content:
This is a laminated textile: woven man-made fiber face fabric plus a polyurethane membrane. Plastic is about 32% by weight, so the fabric is coated or laminated with plastics. Chapter 59, note 2, covers textile fabrics laminated with plastics. Heading 5903 applies to textile fabrics impregnated, coated, covered or laminated with plastics. Note 2(a)(1) of Chapter 59 includes laminated fabrics, with exceptions for products where the textile is only incidental. Heading 5903 therefore fits, rather than 3921, since the textile is not merely a reinforcement.

Subheading 5903.20 covers fabrics laminated with polyurethane. The statistical suffixes are 5903.20.25 (other, over 70% plastics by weight?) and 5903.20.2500 versus 5903.20.2000. Specifically:
- 5903.20.10: Laminated with polyurethane, of man-made fibers, over 70% by weight of rubber or plastics. Here the plastic is 32%, so this is not applicable.
- 5903.20.20: Other, laminated with polyurethane, "Other" covers the rest.
- 5903.20.25: Other.

Real rulings for similar goods (e.g., Gore-type laminates) classify under 5903.20.2500 (other). The 5903.20.20 line is for "Laminated with polyurethane: Of man-made fibers, over 70% plastics", and 5903.20.25 is "Other". I'll go with 5903.20.2500.
